My plot is small, and for tubers mixed with other crops here in the South South, I will mostly depend on the rains and what my household can manage. I will use local planting material and some manure or compost if I can gather it, because chemical fertilizer and chemicals cost money and are not easy for me to use. I will not irrigate, and most of the work will be done by family, but I may hire a little help for heavy work like clearing and mounding.
